import json
from common import WS, freeze_json, frozen, require, sha
from archive_b124_chains import prepare as previous_prepare
from archive_b124_chains_v2 import prepare
from verify_b124_archive_v2 import verify_chain
review = WS / 'scratch-124' / 'review'
runs = {}
for name in ('retention-wrapper-derivation-001', 'retention-wrapper-tests-001', 'confirmation-tool-derivation-001', 'confirmation-fixture-recovery-001', 'confirmation-tool-tests-002'):
    directory = review / name
    receipt_path, log_path = directory / 'receipt.json', directory / 'output.log'
    raw, log = receipt_path.read_bytes(), log_path.read_bytes()
    receipt = json.loads(raw)
    expected = 1 if name == 'confirmation-tool-derivation-001' else 0
    require(receipt['exitCode'] == receipt['childExitCodeAfterCleanup'] == expected and receipt['memory']['breach'] is None and sha(log) == receipt['logSha256'], f'Unverified run {name}')
    receipt_path.chmod(0o444)
    log_path.chmod(0o444)
    runs[name] = {'exitCode': expected, 'receiptSha256': sha(raw), 'logSha256': sha(log)}
original = json.loads(frozen(review / 'confirm' / 'tooling-preflight.json'))
for derivation in original['derivations']:
    frozen(derivation['source']['path'], derivation['source']['sha256'])
    frozen(derivation['output']['path'], derivation['output']['sha256'])
recovery = freeze_json(review / 'confirm' / 'tooling-preflight-recovery-001.json', {'status': 'PASS_PREPARATION_ONLY', 'batch': 124, 'originalPreflightSha256': sha(frozen(review / 'confirm' / 'tooling-preflight.json')), 'fixtureDerivationSha256': sha(frozen(review / 'confirm' / 'test-fixture-derivation-001.json')), 'testCount': 21, 'rendererChecks': original['rendererChecks'], 'testRun': runs['confirmation-tool-tests-002'], 'productionOutputs': [item['output'] for item in original['derivations'] if not item['output']['path'].split('\\')[-1].startswith('test-')], 'limits': 'Original failed preflight retained. Only per-invocation test output roots changed; all assertions and production gates remain byte-exact. No confirmation spec, reviewer launch or candidate acceptance.'})
manifest_raw = frozen(review / 'core-chain.json', 'ab48edf849ec3f7cd1ad09a09f39189da9c16336d663ec62f0f8fa20237401c6')
manifest = json.loads(manifest_raw)
segments = {row['path']: frozen(row['path'], row['sha256']) for row in manifest['segments']}
files, retention = prepare(manifest_raw, segments)
require(files == previous_prepare(manifest_raw, segments)[0], 'Canonical initial archive changed')
binding = {'segments': len(manifest['segments']), 'manifestSha256': sha(manifest_raw), 'retentionSha256': sha(files['retention.json']), 'archivedSegmentIndices': retention['archivedSegmentIndices'], 'localOnlySegmentIndices': [row['index'] for row in retention['localOnlySegments']]}
result = verify_chain(files, binding)
require(result['archivedSegments'] == 26 and result['localOnlySegments'] == 1, 'Unexpected canonical retention')
retained = freeze_json(review / 'retention-wrapper-preflight-001.json', {'status': 'PASS_PREPARATION_ONLY', 'batch': 124, 'derivationSha256': sha(frozen(WS / 'review-tools' / 'b124-retention-v2-derivation.json', '64d2c41f17524315efd4734e7af8eb9954478316b8704aa3c3ab90ac431b1c94')), 'canonicalCore': result, 'canonicalPreparedFilesUnchanged': True, 'tests': 13, 'preservedRuns': runs, 'limits': 'The documented confirmation source wrapper is now protected and its regression cases pass. Actual closure and future confirmation-chain source inventories still require verification. No publication or review acceptance.'})
print(json.dumps({'confirmationRecovery': recovery, 'retentionPreflight': retained}))
